patterns.note: The site uses full-width, single-column content sections, each dominated by a large typographic statement or a minimal brand identity.
Extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography is used as the primary visual element for section content, creating a stark, impactful presence.
A highly restricted monochromatic color palette of dark grey, light grey, and white is used for backgrounds and text, emphasizing the stark and minimal aesthetic.

The initial full-screen hero section containing the logo and company information transforms into a compact, sticky header at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down, revealing subsequent content sections.
Each content section is a distinct, full-viewport height block with a solid background color, presenting a single, impactful message or visual.

technique_notes: The initial hero area acts as a full-page cover, which then shrinks and fixes to the top of the viewport as a sticky header upon scroll, maintaining brand presence.
Content sections are designed as full-viewport height blocks that reveal sequentially as the user scrolls, each presenting a singular, bold typographic statement against a solid background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, blocky, uppercase headings (~4-5x body) dominate the page, with smaller but still bold uppercase text for supporting information.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy; content is sparse and centered within large, full-viewport sections, creating a sense of gravitas and focus.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its extreme minimalism, using an almost brutalist approach with a stark monochromatic palette and oversized, blocky typography as the primary visual and communicative elements. The initial full-page brand statement that transforms into a sticky header is a unique and impactful entry point.
